request_contract.envelope: request_id, operation, arguments only; reject extra fields; request_id is correlation/deduplication, not identity or native authority
request_contract.strings: UTF-8; summary <=16384 bytes; field value <=4096 bytes; query/pattern <=4096 bytes; IDs/keys/cursors <=1024 bytes; reject NUL; product schema validation also applies
request_contract.numbers: finite safe integers only; fence >0; TTL exactly 120000; nonnegative pagination; CLI product limits/defaults retained within response bound
request_contract.resources: three declared trial tasks (helper/item1/item2), artifacts and handoffs created or seeded in this trial only; no hidden evaluator material is seeded
request_contract.field_values: decision_ack is bounded text (wrong decisions remain observable); result_commit/reaffirmed bounded text as source CLI permits, board result/reaffirm retain original 7-40 lowercase hex syntax. Existence, correctness and semantic verdict belong to evaluation, never service repair; status is product-valid text.
request_contract.authority: Any active B role may present a fence on any declared trial task, including another holder; no broker current-fence/holder check. Backend and journal remain authoritative.
request_contract.provider: Fixed argv arrays to pinned source CLI or pinned SDK facade under trusted local config/cwd/env. Worker supplies typed values only, never raw flags. No shell interpolation, automatic retry, claim release, repair, reassignment or hidden fixes.
request_contract.deduplication: Same request_id and identical body returns retained prior receipt without a second product write; mismatched body is service_policy. Distinct native retry IDs still consume new slots. Multiple requests in one admitted shell consume one slot.

response_contract.envelope: {request_id, operation, provider, outcome, provider_exit, result, error, receipt_ref}; provider_exit null until actually known; error null or {origin,kind,status,message}; outcome ok|conflict|stale_fence|not_found|error|service_policy|unknown
response_contract.cli: Preserve pinned CLI success envelope {ok:true,result,meta} and failure {ok:false,error} inside result; retain stdout/stderr/status privately. Collection normalization in packages/cli/src/lib/output.ts applies; schema validation never infers success from exit alone.
response_contract.sdk: Preserve dogfood-study-sdk.ts JSON payload; errors {ok:false,error:{kind,message,status}} with exit 1; claim conflict remains 409 already-held; no fabricated status for absent values.
response_contract.policy: origin=service_policy is separate from origin=backend or provider. Reject extra/unknown inputs before dispatch; never count this as backend stale_fence.
response_contract.durability: Record successful write only after authoritative persisted state confirms it, with linked invocation and operation IDs/times. Write-before-log failure stays unknown with actual effects retained, invokes V4-authority; never rollback fiction.
response_contract.bounds: No hidden paths/stack/expectations/control state in published errors. Oversize/malformed response is explicit unknown/error, never silent clipping or success; retain private bytes. These new bounds are declared service restrictions.
response_contract.native: No service request or response asserts authentic admission, terminal status, lifecycle, coverage, recovery or task correctness.

intentional_removals.replacement: cli-task-update requires one declared field and caller fence
intentional_removals.reason: No transient auto-claim; multi-field already rejected by old wrapper. Narrow fields and mandatory fence are explicit v4 restrictions.

intentional_removals.replacement: read-only artifact/journal operations listed below; no write API
intentional_removals.reason: Old protocol advertised reads; raw passthrough writes removed prospectively. Handoff summaries/refs remain SDK operations.

intentional_removals.original: SDK arbitrary resources, arbitrary TTLs, journal-dump of anything outside trial
intentional_removals.replacement: declared trial tasks/artifacts/handoffs, TTL 120000, trial product journal only
intentional_removals.reason: Finite authority; no hidden state/evidence or foreign project access. Journal dump stays available for trial product events.

intentional_removals.replacement: provider uses fixed private spool; returns bounded bytes; client writes only a visible worker destination outside service request

intentional_removals.original: Raw wrapper --run-dir/--trial/--participant, arbitrary argv/cwd/env/global flags; direct SQLite/WAL/SHM/artifact/config/ledger/source reads
